description:
As an advisor who forgot my password, I want to reset it by email so that I can sign in again.
Acceptance criteria:
- Given the login page, when I click "Forgot password?", then I can enter my email
- Given any email, when I submit it, then I see "If the account exists, we sent a reset link." (no account enumeration)
- Given a reset link older than 1 hour, when I open it, then I see that the link expired
